localChanges: With the New interface preview on, a meeting with another leader shows who you're meeting and what you know of them: peace or war, when you first met, and with an embassy their government, cities and treasury. The talks so far read as a conversation, and your replies are numbered buttons: press a number to choose one, Enter for the first and Escape to say Good bye (#752).

log: In a meeting with another leader, the first reply offered, which Enter takes, is now the one that costs you nothing: refusing a demand for tribute, an exchange of advances or a call to cancel a treaty, accepting peace, and Good bye rather than a demand of your own (civ-clone/web-renderer#674).
chore: computer players choose their reply in a meeting whatever order the replies come in (#74)
